MEDICAL.gov_quote: Qualified registered patients are allowed to purchase up to 2.5 ounces from a dispensary in a 14-day period.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Arkansas?
MEDICAL.gov_section: Qualified registered patients are allowed to purchase up to 2.5 ounces from a dispensary in a 14-day period.
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://healthy.arkansas.gov/programs-services/data-statistics-registries/medical-marijuana/faqs/.

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Yes. To be protected under the Arkansas Medical Marijuana Amendment, your marijuana must be purchased from one of the licensed Arkansas dispensaries.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Exact quote found verbatim on the Arkansas Department of Health website. The answer is correct and fully supported by the cited source. No corrections needed.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Arkansas?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: Yes. To be protected under the Arkansas Medical Marijuana Amendment, your marijuana must be purchased from one of the licensed Arkansas dispensaries.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: No. Qualifying registered patients and their designated caregivers cannot grow or cultivate medical marijuana. Marijuana-infused products must be purchased through the licensed Arkansas medical marijuana dispensaries.
MEDICAL_GROW.validation_notes: Exact quote found verbatim on the official Arkansas Department of Health Medical Marijuana FAQs page. The answer is correct and the URL is accessible. No changes required.
MEDICAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to grow cannabis in the state of Arkansas?
MEDICAL_GROW.gov_section: No. Qualifying registered patients and their designated caregivers cannot grow or cultivate medical marijuana. Marijuana-infused products must be purchased through the licensed Arkansas medical marijuana dispensaries.
